story.title: My Sister and Me
paragraphs_en: Anu is my sister. She helps me do my homework.
Some days I do not like to do my homework. But Anu makes me sit down.
Anu has a big cycle. She teaches me to ride it.
When I fall she comes running to help me.
Anu also fights with me. Then I get angry.
But after some time she is sorry. That is why I love my sister Anu.

sentences.text_en: She teaches me to ride it.

sentences.text_en: When I fall she comes running to help me.

sentences.text_en: But after some time she is sorry.

sentences.text_en: That is why I love my sister Anu.
sentences.text_vi: Đó là lý do vì sao mình yêu chị Anu.
